citation: BOxCrete: A Bayesian Optimization Open-Source AI Model for Concrete Strength Forecasting and Mix Optimization (2026). arXiv:2603.21525.
description: BOxCrete is the SustainableConcrete repository published by Meta's research team for probabilistic concrete-strength prediction and mix design. It uses Gaussian-process models to estimate strength over curing time, global-warming potential and optionally slump from mixture composition. The repository includes a combined mortar and concrete training table, installation instructions and example notebooks for fitting models and exploring strength-emission trade-offs. Inputs are material quantities, curing ages and design bounds; outputs include predicted curves, uncertainty bands and candidate mixtures. Coverage is material-level and globally configurable, while calibration depends on the available material sources and experiments. Public source is free under MIT. A limitation is that model predictions and proposed mixtures need physical testing for the intended local materials and construction requirements; a predictive result is not a certified mix design. The tool can parameterise material alternatives in infrastructure design simulations, complementary to the building representations of EnergyPlus (model-energyplus). The README links the 2026 BOxCrete preprint. No training data, model weights or experimental results were downloaded.
name: BOxCrete sustainable concrete mix model
